claims: SpaceX is not directly involved in the launch or flight operations of the Artemis II mission.
Artemis II mission uses NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis II mission uses Orion capsule.
Artemis II is a crewed lunar flyby.
Artemis II focuses on testing the SLS rocket.
Artemis II focuses on testing the Orion capsule.
Artemis II does not land on the moon.
SpaceX is contracted to develop the Starship Human Landing System (HLS).
Starship Human Landing System (HLS) is to land astronauts on the lunar surface for later missions.
SpaceX is focused on landing crew during Artemis III.
SpaceX is focused on landing crew during Artemis IV
